key_reasons: E3 establishes fixed-model context weight-to-value alignment and utility over uniform pooling. It supplies no cross-input structural law, no attribution of that utility to pure-state geometry, and no separation from the matched comparators in E4. This limits the empirical bridge; it does not establish that a stronger contribution is impossible.

Natural direction screened: retention of sparse relational evidence under appended irrelevant context. With unchanged contextual features and a repeated distractor block, every existing head has z_r(N)=b_r+(A_r+N B_r)/(C_r+N D_r), where A and B are sums of (q+eps)u and C and D are sums of q+eps. Dilution and exact invariance conditions here are elementary normalized-pooling algebra. The epsilon floor makes D positive for a nonempty block. This alone is neither a nontrivial theory target nor a distinction from other positive normalized attentions. In real sentences the frozen contextual representations can also change after insertion, so feature preservation requires separate evidence.

Natural direction screened: ordered-entity reversal and an externally specified inverse-relation schema. Exact output equivariance is meaningful, but a sufficient construction using a shared unitary state transformation, transformed effects, paired values and biases is generic equivariant-model reasoning. E1 does not impose that construction. Requiring it would change the method or add an unverified premise; an obstruction proved only for state overlaps would still leave the complete learned value/readout pathway unconstrained.

I did not identify a sharper theorem for either direction that avoids the declared known-tool collisions while retaining the actual contextual encoder, signed input-dependent values, normalization and feasible shared preparation. Naming an unproved stronger theorem would not yet supply a defensible research question under this packet.
risks: This is a bounded negative screening result, not an impossibility theorem or an exhaustive literature verdict. Primary-source checking could reveal a useful unresolved problem or show that a later sharper target is already known.

A future natural premise should be fixed by semantics or task generation before examining labels or model outcomes, apply across inputs, and survive evaluation of the complete learned readout. Current evidence does not justify choosing favorable cases or restricting values after observing them.
New cross-input evidence would be needed even for an unchanged head. A modified equivariant or otherwise constrained head inherits no automatic L4 confirmation.
No stopped family is recommended for reopening; no phase necessity, comparator superiority, quantum advantage, rank necessity or L5 acceptance follows from this assessment.
corrections_to_primary: No primary draft was supplied, so these are independent constraints rather than corrections to a candidate.
Treat existing L4 as evidence for useful context alignment on the fixed benchmark, with its stated five-seed assumptions. Do not promote it to support for a newly proposed cross-input premise.

Keep algebraic identities, sufficient architectural constructions and genuinely new theorem targets separate. None of the screened identities or constructions alone meets the substantive-theory requirement.

confidence.basis: Only E1-E8 in the frozen packet; no external sources, repository inspection, experiments or checkpoint access.
